payload.package: v2 ships as the branch state: the M7 build (5b49669: engine/phone.ts + i8-phone.test.ts + the board hook) plus M8 (a0d243b) plus the M9 close-out to come. The ledger grew by 8 requirements, 3 v2 ADRs, 1 setup guidance node, 2 RAID entries; the drawn build and spike machines with their walked records ship in the iteration folder. No zip lane - unchanged from i3-i5.
payload.entry_script: README.md and RUNME.ps1 stand unchanged at the root. The phone lane adds a NEW optional config file, ~/.se/<project>/phone.json - machine-local, gitignored-by-location (it lives outside the repo entirely, in the state home), correctly excluded from the artifact; its setup is documented in guidance-phone-setup, the owner-physical enablement step.
